The Hutt homeworld. They ''renamed'' it after they drove all the Evocii off planet. The name means ''{{'}}Glorious Jewel{{'}}'' in Huttese.|[[Jodo Kast]]|''[[Boba Fett: Twin Engines of Destruction]]''}} '''Nal Hutta''' ('''Glorious Jewel''' in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]), also known simply as '''Hutta''', was the capital of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and was located in the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]]. It was formerly known as '''Evocar''' and was the original home world of the [[Evocii]], who were ousted by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] in [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], who migrated from their original home world of [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] along with their servants the [[t'landa Til]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was controlled by the ancient ruling Hutt families, who also ruled its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] from Nal Hutta and became the new capital of Hutt Space. ==Description== {{Quote|Certain parts of the planet still ''are'' beautiful, if you like plants, but the Hutts have erected all sorts palaces, pleasure gardens, and clan houses.|Jodo Kast|}} [[File:The_bog.png|thumb|left|180px|The factories and swamps of Nal Hutta]] Nal Hutta, or as it was originally known, Evocar, was a very large planet deep within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and formed part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]], however it lacked natural heavy metals meaning its density was less than that of most worlds. The planet was originally a lush jungle world with vast oceans, though the Hutts eventually transformed it into a polluted and barren wasteland. Once it became known as Nal Hutta, much of the surface became covered by flat, marshy bogs, stagnant, muddy puddles and patches of sickly marsh grass inhabited by insects and spiders. The few other species to survive the Hutt's environmental changes mutated and adapted to the pollutant laden environment. Some, like the [[Chemilizard]] were able to extract nutrients from the industrial waste of the Hutts. Others developed extensive chemical defenses. The areas still habitable by the native species were viciously competed for making the many of the species on Nal Hutta some of the most aggressive animals in the galaxy. The [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was also polluted by strip-mining operations and heavy industrialization, and a greasy rain drizzled down on the surface, although its terrain was not to the extent of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. Raw materials were constantly strip-mined from the planet's surface and shipped to Nar Shaddaa for processing and export.
The capital city, [[Bilbousa/Legends|Bilbousa]] and the [[Guarja Shipyards]] were located on the planet. The Huttese translation of Nal Hutta into '''Glorious Jewel''' stemmed from the nearby massive, [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Oktos Nebula/Legends|gas cloud]], which contained the planet [[Ganath/Legends|Ganath]]. The planet was ruled by the oldest Hutt families, known as the Clans of the Ancients, who watched over the activities of both Nal Hutta and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] from their homes. ==History==
[[File:Nal_hutta.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Nal Hutta orbited by Nar Shaddaa, formerly known as Evocar]]
===Hutt Empire=== {{Quote|Basel of Tion and the holowright of holowrights himself, Peshosloc, both have Xim, in their versions, perishing after the Third Battle. Direus'pei, on the other hand, keeps Xim alive, shackled in the dungeons of Evocar, which did not fall under Hutt control until 10,000 years after Xim's time.|[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]], ''[[The Despotica Reader]]'', [[The Despotica Reader, Third Edition|Third Edition]]|{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek02/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part I)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}}} Evocar was home to the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Evocii]]. Prior to [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], the Hutt settlers owned a small province on Evocar. Due likely to their legendary greed, the Hutt's ownership of Evocar continued to grow through business deals where they traded their technology with the relatively primitive Evocii for portions of land. ===Old Republic=== {{Quote|In fact, we Hutts know a good deal about remaking worlds. When we arrived here from Varl, for example, Glorious Jewel was not the paradise you see now, but a primitive world of dense forests and untamed seas.|[[Borga Besadii Diori|Borga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]|''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''}} Following the [[Hutt Cataclysms|destruction]] of the Hutt home-world of [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] in [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], the Hutts collaborated with [[Vippit]] lawyers from [[Alee]] in buying out the planet from the Evocii, regarding it as a suitable new home. Using both legal and violent measures, the Hutts established themselves as the rulers of the planet and renamed it Nal Hutta, as the new capital of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], the successor of the [[Hutt Empire]]. Hutt palaces, amusement parks and other constructions were built all over Evocar, and the Evocii could do nothing about it. The Hutts destroyed the planet's lush mountainous rainforests, terraforming the planet into what they considered paradise. The Evocii appealed to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], however the contracts signed were legally binding, and the Republic ruled in favor of the Hutts. Many of the Evocii were eventually evicted by the Hutts, and relocated to the planet's fifth moon, which would later be known as [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the Smugglers' Moon. The Hutts then destroyed the remaining Evocii agriculture and whatever was left of the original terrain and then terraformed (destroyed) any remaining patches of land. Most of the Evocii who remained on Nal Hutta were enslaved to build the cities of Nal Hutta. [[File:HuttaNarShaddaa_TOR.png|thumb|left|200px|Hutta during the reign of the Eternal Empire]] The few remaining Evocii not enslaved in the cities banded together into rebel tribes to harass the Hutts and their interests, ultimately they were defeated and exterminated. The resettled Evocii were exploited as indentured labor to build the cities of the moon. Although the Vertical City was only starting to be built, it quickly began to prosper along with Nal Hutta. When the cities of Nal Hutta were completed, the Evocii were relocated to assist the Evocii on Nar Shaddaa, along side Nar Shaddaa's native [[Gank/Legends|Ganks]]. [[14,500 BBY|Five centuries later]], the entire moon was urbanized and the Evocii were freed of their labor by the Hutts. The Evocii then took refuge in Nar Shaddaa's [[Nar Shaddaa's Undercity|under-city]], along with the Ganks and began to mutate into savages due to various technologies practiced on the moon. For about eleven thousand years, [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and to a lesser extent, Nal Hutta itself, [[Coruscant of the Outer Rim|rivaled]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as the hub of interstellar trade. With the disruption of the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|Ootmian Pabol]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], Nal Hutta and its moon gradually devolved into havens for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and other criminals. During the [[Dark Wars]] in [[3951 BBY]], Nal Hutta was enslaving refugees after buying them from the [[Exchange]] in the [[Refugee Sector]] on Nar Shaddaa.''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' During the [[Great Galactic War]] beginning in [[3681 BBY]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the Galactic Republic, the Hutts managed to remain neutral, ensuring their world remained exactly as they liked it. In the conflict with the [[Eternal Empire]], a [[Gizka/Legends|gizka]] infestation forced a [[quarantine]] on the cargo ports of Nal Hutta.{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|More Trouble with Gizka}} Nal Hutta continued to serve as the Hutts' base during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the world was generally left undisturbed by the galaxy-wide conflict. The Hutt Grand Council was situated on Nal Hutta during the war, apart from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], who operated out of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and had [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii]] represent him in person.{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}} It was to Nal Hutta [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] fled after his [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|prison break]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], where he was incarcerated by the Council for refusing to hand over a holo-diary which contained the council's many crimes. After escaping the Council's prison, he and his girlfriend [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] fled across murky swamplands to [[Mama/Legends|Mama's]] [[Mama the Hutt's house/Legends|hut]], where he borrowed her starship and fled to [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], pursued by two [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]]; [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
[[File:GardullasPalace-HFZ.png|thumb|left|240px|[[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt's Palace]] on Nal Hutta]]
Later in the War around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], after escape on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] (disguised of [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]]) made their way to Nal Hutta, where Kenobi, to Bane's incredulity, intended to crash their [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter/Legends|HCT-2001 ''Dragonboat''-class Reugeot 905 freighter]] into the swamps to get Republic authorities off their trail. Surviving the crash, the three of them abandoned the freighter and made their way to the [[Bilbousa Bazaar/Legends|Bilbousa Bazaar]], a marketplace in the planet's capital city, Bilbousa. There, Kenobi hoped they could buy a new starship, though Bane pointed out that as they undoubtedly had a bounty on their heads for escaping, they first had to replace their prison fatigues. To re-equip themselves with bounty hunting gear, Bane took them to [[Pablo's pawnshop/Legends|Pablo's Pawnshop]], a choice venue of his that was operated by the pawnbroker [[Pablo/Legends|Pablo]]. At the pawnshop, Bane found some new armor and equipment, including a new hat. As Kenobi had suspected, Bane sprayed Kenobi with [[Knockout gas/Legends|knockout gas]] as they were departing, leaving Kenobi to be arrested by the local authorities. However, Kenobi turned the frequency of the tracking device over to his captors, who shot Bane and Eval's ship down. Kenobi, meanwhile, escaped from captivity and purchased another ship, and when Bane and Eval found him smugly waiting for them, they agreed to make him a partner in their scheme and captured by [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] Guards and escape. After Three Bounty Hunters leaving Hutta on [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] on [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]], who is visiting the [[Palpatine/Legends|Chancellor]] and is still unaware of the secret mission, does not take this decision well, and Palpatine exploits this by deliberately sending him After some [[Telekinesis/Legends|brutal questioning]] of the locals on Anakin's part, the two Jedi learn about the next likely whereabouts of the fugitives ship, since the ship seller decided to fuel up the ship only just enough to force them to seek out his brother's refueling station on [[Orondia/Legends|Orondia]]. After spotting their quarry as they prepare to leave, Anakin decides to ram the ship into submission and board it in midflight, but is foiled by Bane and a subsequent crash-landing of both parties resulting from the furious chase through a local fuel-processing facility.{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}} In later arround [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], after [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] set out to assemble an [[Army/Legends|army]] of followers, beginning their search at a [[Black Sun fortress/Legends|fortress]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] belonging to the leaders of a branch of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate, negotiations with the syndicate branch's [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] leaders were quick to sour, leading Savage Opress to [[Sai cha/Legends|kill]] them while Maul recruited the organization's [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]], [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]], who authorized an alliance in the fallen leaders stead with freshly gained supplies and a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Black Sun foot soldier/Legends|Black Sun foot soldiers]] in tow, Pre Vizsla and Maul were approached by [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]], leader of a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-dealing [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], the [[Pyke/Legends|Pykes]] moved to willingly join the growing assembly. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] formed a criminal [[organization]] called the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] and he wished to [[Mission to Nal Hutta/Legends|secure a partnership]] with the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] on Nal Hutta, in addition to his [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] allies. There, Death Watch attended to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] injuries before Vizsla invited Darth Maul to talk, during which the two found they had a mutual enemy in the form of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] equally despised by both [[Gender/Legends|men]]. Upon that shared animosity, Maul and Vizsla founded an alliance in pursuit of mutual benefit: the Sith would aid Death Watch in [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|deposing]] [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]], while Death Watch would assist the Sith in their plans to punish Kenobi for his [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|actions]] against Maul a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] prior. With their newest allies, the hutts summoned five [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], [[Marrok (anooba)/Legends|Marrok]], [[Latts Razzi/Legends|Latts Razzi]], [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]] and [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], sugi hurl a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] at Maul's head. Before it could reach its target, Opress halted it and the knife went hurling back to the feet of the anooba, Marrok. Jabba then had his bounty hunters eliminate the two Sith Lords and Vizsla. The two Sith merely swatted the guards aside while Vizsla used his [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] to help cover their retreat. By the time the flames had fanned, the Sith and Vizsla had a head start on their escape. Death Watch set out for Hutta with a small attack force was comprised of three [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class starfighters]] loaded with squads of Death Watch foot soldiers and three [[Sarisa-class gunship/Legends|''Sarisa''-class gunships]] headed toward Nal Hutta and landed at the [[Hutt Council Chamber/Legends|Hutt Council Chamber]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] Escape.''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]'' Though the mission ended as a failure, [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]] was captured by Bo-Katan and her soldiers. Oruba stated he knew not of where his allies were hiding. Maul then ordered for Opress to kill him as the elder Hutt proved useless to them, but Oruba stated that his allies were holed up in Jabba's [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on the Outer Rim world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Still, Maul had Opress kill Oruba. They then [[Attack on Jabba's Palace/Legends|set course for Tatooine]]. ===Galactic Empire=== {{Quote|Nal Hutta. Means 'Glorious Jewel' in Huttese, but trust me, pal, it ain't pretty. Bunch of swamps and bogs, and the whole place stinks like a sewer in the middle of a garbage dump.|Han Solo to Chewbacca|''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''}} [[File:Bilbousa.png|thumb|right|350px|The Bilbousa spaceport on Nal Hutta]] During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established nominal control over Nal Hutta, but for the most part the Hutt ruling families were left to control day to day affairs, with the Empire stepping in only when searching for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel sympathizers]] or other criminals. ===Yuuzhan Vong War=== {{Quote|What a vile world this is.''"
"''The Hutts know it as 'Glorious Jewel'.|[[Malik Carr]] and [[Nom Anor]]|}} During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Nal Hutta was [[Battle of Nal Hutta|conquered]] following an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] by the extragalactic aliens in retaliation for the Hutts' treachery in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]. The Y'Toub system was surrounded by several of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s most deadly warships. Several organic creations were sent to Nal Hutta and its moon Nar Shaddaa for multiple purposes. Different types of bacteria killed most of the inhabitants, before processing their remains into the soil of Nal Hutta. All of the technology on the planet was broken down and also absorbed into the soil, thus turning Nal Hutta into a lifeless barren world. However, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] still remained for two years during the Yuuzhan Vong's rule. The Yuuzhan Vong [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]] the lifeless barren surface of Nal Hutta (into an unknown result) to suit themselves, resulting in the second complete change of the planet's terrain. This process was ongoing, and the Yuuzhan Vong reached out from the Y'Toub system, swallowing all of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], and desolating the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Cartel]] [[Hutt Empire|territories]] in the process. As a result, a [[Hutt underground]] was formed, and the New Republic [[Raid on Nal Hutta|raided]] the world in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]]. The Hutt families and the resistance movement abandoned Nal Hutta as their base of operations of the empire at the close of the Vong war in 28 ABY, moving instead to the desert planet of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], a world on which the Hutts historically had a heavy presence [[Arkanis sector/Legends|beyond]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. ===Legacy era=== Despite the efforts of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], their introduced vegetation and fauna failed to thrive on both Nal Hutta and Nar Shaddaa due to the entrenched Hutt ecosystem. In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], they abandoned the vongformed planet and moon. Over the following decades, the Hutts would gradually reclaim both Nal Hutta and its moon. There were also criminals that were fortunate enough to have survived the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] who took shelter on the now vongformed planet as well as Nar Shaddaa. Like its moon in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], it would not openly ally itself with the [[Five Worlds]] and remained independent. However, Nal Hutta did join the [[Confederation]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], although the Hutts themselves were relatively neutral. [[41 ABY|Later in the war]] the [[Hutt underground|Hutts]] finally joined their fellow criminals, and were absorbed into the Confederation as well. ==Behind the scenes== The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Nal Hutta in the [[Kanchen sector/Legends|Kanchen sector]], which is actually located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]] depicted the surface of Nal Hutta much as it had been described in previous sources.
